_metadata.description: Maps Entra ID departments and groups to Process Manager roles
notes: departmentMapping: Maps the 'Department' field from Entra ID user profile
groupMapping: Maps Entra ID security group names (not yet implemented in Logic App)
_default: Fallback role when no mapping is found
Role names must exactly match the 'display' names in Process Manager
This file is ONLY used when mappingMode is set to 'mapped'
When using 'dynamic' mode, the department name is used directly as the role
